professionalSummary: Experienced project manager in snack‑food packaging, successfully delivering capital upgrade projects within scheduled shutdowns, coordinating suppliers and contractors, managing commissioning, and ensuring timely handover to production.
experienceHighlights: Planned and executed the replacement of a vertical form‑fill‑seal machine and checkweigher on line 4 at Hollins Snacks, fitting the installation into a nine‑day planned shutdown in August 2023.
Coordinated equipment supplier and two installation contractors, reviewed method statements, and issued permits to work in collaboration with the plant’s safety advisor.
Ran commissioning with the supplier’s engineer, completed factory and site acceptance test protocols, and handed the line back to the production manager with a signed handover certificate.
Maintained the project budget tracker and reported committed and actual spend against the approved capital request at the monthly capex review.
Prepared and shared a lessons‑learned review for the line 4 project with the engineering team before the line 6 upgrade.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Line 4 handover certificate and site acceptance test summary, listing test cases, punch‑list items closed before handover, and signatures of the production manager and the supplier’s engineer.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work‑sample sources establish the candidate’s experience in planning, coordinating, commissioning, and reporting on packaging line upgrades, and confirm possession of an APM Project Management Qualification. They do not provide quantitative evidence of realized benefits such as throughput gains, downtime reduction, or payback periods.
